purpose: Teach: じゅん/素子/すぅ/稔/ヤマト/松子/春日/立花

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお友達のじゅんさんと公園で会われたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad ran into your friend Jun at the park today.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Soft opening. Speaking as if sharing something she noticed and wants to mention gently. Almost conversational. No rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと素子おばさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw Dad and Auntie Motoko at the park.
lines.style: Quick, bright opening. Eager to share. Small voice, but present and clear. The tone of a child who has something to tell and wants you to listen.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「すぅっと深呼吸する練習」を教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad showed you that deep breathing exercise, didn't he?
lines.style: Gentle, knowing tone. Phrased as a soft realization rather than a question. Warm recognition of something quiet and good.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに稔おじさんの絵を見せて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad let me see the picture of Uncle Minoru.
lines.style: Earnest, proud tone. Clear enunciation on the important words. The voice of a child sharing something that felt special. Sincere without performing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがヤマト便のドライバーさんに丁寧に挨拶されたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad greeted that Yamato delivery driver so politely.
lines.style: Admiring, reflective. Noting something with quiet appreciation. Observant voice—picking up on the small kindnesses she sees.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと松子おばさんのお祝いに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got to go to Auntie Matsuko's celebration with Dad.
lines.style: Bright and pleased. Direct, simple excitement. Child's voice is warm and genuine. Happy to have been included in something grown-up.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが春日大社のしか、つまり鹿を見せて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad showed you the deer at Kasuga Taisha.
lines.style: Warm, almost tender tone. Marveling gently at something he experienced. The voice of someone sharing in his wonder. Soft pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと立花生け花の体験会に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad took me to try ikebana at Tachibana.
lines.style: Satisfied, content. Speaking with quiet pride of something he did with his father. Clear, genuine warmth. Closing tone—the pleasure of a good memory settling in.
